units.zh: 天福十二年夏五月乙酉朔，契丹所署大丞相、政事令、東京留守、燕王趙延壽為永康烏裕所縶，既而烏裕召蕃漢臣僚於鎮州牙署，矯其主遣詔，命烏裕嗣位，於是發哀成服。
units.en: On the first day of the fifth month in summer of the twelfth year of Tianfu, Zhao Yanshou—the Khitan appointee as Grand Chancellor, Director of Government Affairs, Eastern Capital defender, and Prince of Yan—was seized by Yongkang Wu Yu. Wu Yu then gathered Khitan and Chinese officials at the Zhenzhou headquarters, forged an edict in the Khitan emperor's name naming himself successor, and proclaimed mourning and donned mourning dress.
units.literal: In summer, on the first day (yiyou) of the fifth month of the twelfth year of Tianfu, Zhao Yanshou—whom the Khitan had appointed Grand Chancellor, Director of Government Affairs, Defender of the Eastern Capital, and Prince of Yan—was seized by Yongkang Wu Yu. Thereupon Wu Yu summoned Khitan and Chinese officials at the headquarters in Zhenzhou, forged an edict in his lord's name appointing Wu Yu to succeed to the throne, and then proclaimed mourning and assumed mourning garments.

units.zh: 辛卯，詔取五月十二日車駕南幸。
units.en: On xinmao an edict set the twelfth day of the fifth month for the emperor's southward progress.
units.literal: On xinmao an edict fixed the twelfth day of the fifth month for the imperial carriage to proceed south.

units.zh: 甲午，以判太原府事劉崇為北京留守，命皇子承訓。
units.en: On jiawu Liu Chong, provisional administrator of Taiyuan, was appointed Defender of the Northern Capital, and Imperial Prince Chengxun received his commission.
units.literal: On jiawu Liu Chong, who was administering Taiyuan Prefecture, was made Defender of the Northern Capital, and Imperial Prince Chengxun was given orders.

units.zh: 武德使李暉大內巡檢。
units.en: Li Hui, commissioner of the Wude office, was appointed grand inspector of the inner palace.
units.literal: Li Hui, Wude Commissioner, was made Grand Inner Inspector.

units.zh: 丙申，帝發河東，取陰地關路幸東京。
units.en: On bingshen the emperor left Hedong and, by way of Yindi Pass, set out for the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: On bingshen the Emperor departed Hedong, taking the Yindi Pass route on his progress to the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 時星官言，太歲在午，不利南巡，故路出陰地。
units.en: The court astronomers had warned that with Jupiter in the Horse sign a southern tour was ill-omened, so the route was diverted through Yindi instead.
units.literal: At the time the astronomers said that with the Year Star in the noon position, a southern tour was inauspicious, and therefore the route went out by way of Yindi.

units.zh: 丁酉，史宏肇奏，澤州刺史翟令奇以郡來降。
units.en: On dingyou Shi Hongzhao reported that Ze Prefecture governor Zhai Lingqi had submitted the district.
units.literal: On dingyou Shi Hongzhao reported that Zhai Lingqi, prefect of Ze Prefecture, had surrendered the commandery.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·李萬超傳》：史宏肇路經澤州，刺史翟令奇堅壁拒命。
units.en: (The Song History biography of Li Wanchao adds that when Shi Hongzhao marched through Ze, Prefect Zhai Lingqi held the walls and defied him.)
units.literal: (According to the Song History, Biography of Li Wanchao: Shi Hongzhao passed through Ze Prefecture, and the prefect Zhai Lingqi shut the walls and refused to submit.)

units.zh: 萬超馳至城下，諭之曰：「今契丹北遁，天下無主，并州劉公，仗大義，定中土，所向風靡，後服者族，盍早圖之。」
units.en: Wanchao rode to the foot of the walls and urged him: 'The Khitan have withdrawn north; the empire has no ruler. Liu of Bingzhou acts in the name of righteousness to pacify the heartland, and resistance crumbles before him. Latecomers face extinction of their clans—why not decide now?'
units.literal: Wanchao galloped to below the walls and instructed him, saying: 'Now the Khitan have fled north and the realm has no master. Lord Liu of Bingzhou, upholding the great cause, is settling the central lands; wherever he turns, men yield like wind before a storm. Those who submit late will have their clans exterminated—why not plan early?'

units.zh: 令奇乃開門迎納，宏肇即留萬超權州事。）〉
units.en: Thereupon Lingqi opened the gates and admitted them, and Hongzhao left Wanchao in temporary charge of the prefecture.)〉
units.literal: Lingqi then opened the gates and received them; Hongzhao at once left Wanchao in provisional charge of the prefecture.)〉

units.zh: 是日，契丹所署汴州節度使蕭翰迎郇國公李從益至東京，請從益知南朝軍國事。
units.en: That same day Xiao Han, the Khitan-appointed governor of Bian, brought Li Congyi, Duke of Xun, to the Eastern Capital and asked him to take charge of the Southern Court's military and civil affairs.
units.literal: That day Xiao Han, military governor of Bian Prefecture as appointed by the Khitan, welcomed the Duke of Xun, Li Congyi, to the Eastern Capital and requested that Congyi administer the military and state affairs of the Southern Court.

units.zh: 己亥，蕭翰發離東京北去。
units.en: On jihai Xiao Han left the Eastern Capital and marched north.
units.literal: On jihai Xiao Han set out from the Eastern Capital and departed north.

units.zh: 乙巳，契丹永康王烏裕自鎮州還蕃，行次定州，以定州節度副使耶律忠為定州節度使，孫方簡為雲州節度使。
units.en: On yisi Khitan Prince Yongkang Wu Yu withdrew from Zhenzhou toward home; pausing at Dingzhou he appointed Yelü Zhong, Ding's deputy governor, as governor of Ding, and Sun Fangjian as governor of Yun.
units.literal: On yisi the Khitan Prince of Yongkang, Wu Yu, returned to the Khitan lands from Zhenzhou; halting at Ding Prefecture, he made Yelü Zhong, deputy military governor of Ding, military governor of Ding, and Sun Fangjian military governor of Yun.

units.zh: 方簡不受命，遂歸狼山。
units.en: Fangjian refused the commission and withdrew to Langshan.
units.literal: Fangjian did not accept the appointment and thereupon returned to Lang Mountain.

units.zh: 戊申，車駕至絳州，本州刺史李從朗以郡降。
units.en: On wushen the emperor reached Jiang Prefecture, where the incumbent governor Li Conglang submitted the district.
units.literal: On wushen the imperial carriage reached Jiang Prefecture; Li Conglang, the native prefect, surrendered the commandery.

units.zh: 初，契丹遣偏校成霸卿、曹可璠等守其郡，帝建義之始，不時歸命，及車駕至，帝耀兵於城下，不令攻擊，從朗等遂降。
units.en: Earlier the Khitan had left subordinate officers Cheng Baqing and Cao Kefan to garrison the prefecture; they had not come in when the emperor first raised his banner. When he arrived he paraded troops before the walls without ordering an assault, and Conglang and his party surrendered.
units.literal: Earlier the Khitan had sent the junior commanders Cheng Baqing, Cao Kefan, and others to hold the commandery; from the beginning of the Emperor's upholding of righteousness they had not promptly submitted. When the imperial carriage arrived, the Emperor displayed troops below the walls but did not order an attack, and Conglang and the others thereupon surrendered.

units.zh: 六月乙卯，契丹河中節度使趙贊起復河中節度使。
units.en: In the sixth month, on yimao, Zhao Zan—Khitan appointee as Hezhong governor—was reinstated as governor of Hezhong.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on yimao, Zhao Zan, Khitan military governor of Hezhong, was restored to military governor of Hezhong.

units.zh: 是日，契丹右僕射兼中書侍郎、平章事張礪卒於鎮州。
units.en: That day Zhang Li, the Khitan right vice director and grand councillor, died at Zhenzhou.
units.literal: That day Zhang Li, Khitan Right Vice Director, concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Grand Councillor, died at Zhenzhou.

units.zh: 丙辰，車駕至洛，兩京文武百僚自新安相次奉迎。
units.en: On bingchen the emperor reached Luoyang, where civil and military officials from both capitals met him in succession from Xin'an.
units.literal: On bingchen the imperial carriage reached Luo; civil and military officials of the two capitals, in succession from Xin'an, came forward to welcome it.

units.zh: 郇國公李從益、唐明宗淑妃王氏皆賜死於東京。
units.en: At the Eastern Capital, Duke of Xun Li Congyi and Tang Mingzong's Honored Consort Wang were both ordered to take their own lives.
units.literal: The Duke of Xun, Li Congyi, and the Honored Consort Wang of Emperor Mingzong of Tang were both granted death at the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 甲子，車駕至東京。
units.en: On jiazi the emperor entered the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: On jiazi the imperial carriage reached the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 丙寅，以漢州就糧歸捷指揮使張建雄為濮州刺史，以金州守禦指揮使康彥環為金州防禦使。
units.en: On bingyin Zhang Jianxiong, commander of the Han provisioning victory corps, was appointed prefect of Pu, and Kang Yanhuan, Jin's defense commander, was made defense commissioner of Jin.
units.literal: On bingyin Zhang Jianxiong, commander of the Return-to-Victory Army for Provisioning at Han Prefecture, was made prefect of Pu; Kang Yanhuan, commander of the Jin Prefecture Defense Army, was made defense commissioner of Jin.

units.zh: 建雄、彥環皆因亂害本州刺史，自知州事，故有是命。
units.en: During the chaos Jianxiong and Yanhuan had each killed his prefect and taken charge of the prefecture himself, which led to these commissions.
units.literal: Jianxiong and Yanhuan had each, amid the turmoil, killed the native prefect of their prefecture and themselves administered prefectural affairs; therefore these appointments were made.

units.zh: 以北京知進奏王從璋為內客省使。
units.en: Wang Congzhang, Beijing liaison for memorials to court, was appointed commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau.
units.literal: Wang Congzhang, who handled memorials from the Northern Capital, was made commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau.

units.zh: 戊辰，制：「大赦天下。
units.en: On wuchen an edict declared: 'Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm.
units.literal: On wuchen an edict proclaimed: 'A general amnesty is granted throughout the realm.

units.zh: 應天福十二年六月十五日昧爽已前，天下見禁罪人，已結正未結正，已發覺未發覺，除十惡五逆外，罪無輕重，咸赦除之。
units.en: All prisoners held anywhere in the realm before dawn on the fifteenth day of the sixth month, Tianfu twelve—whether their cases were closed or still pending, known or still concealed—are pardoned without regard to severity, except for the ten capital crimes and the five treasons.
units.literal: For all prisoners now under restraint throughout the realm before dawn on the fifteenth day of the sixth month of the twelfth year of Tianfu—whether judgment has been finalized or not, whether the crime has been discovered or not—apart from the ten abominations and the five rebellions, crimes regardless of severity are all pardoned and remitted.

units.zh: 諸州去年殘稅並放。
units.en: Last year's unpaid taxes in every prefecture are cancelled.
units.literal: Outstanding taxes of last year in all prefectures are remitted.

units.zh: 東、西京一百里內，放今年夏稅；
units.en: Within a hundred li of the two capitals, this summer's land tax is waived;
units.literal: Within a hundred li of the Eastern and Western Capitals, this year's summer tax is remitted;

units.zh: 一百里外及京城，今年屋稅並放一半。
units.en: beyond that radius and in the capital districts, half of this year's dwelling tax is remitted.
units.literal: beyond a hundred li and in the capital cities, this year's dwelling tax is remitted by half.

units.zh: 契丹所授職任，不議改更。
units.en: Posts granted by the Khitan regime will not be reviewed for replacement.
units.literal: Offices conferred by the Khitan are not to be discussed for change or replacement.

units.zh: 諸貶降官，未量移者與量移；
units.en: Demoted officials not yet reassigned will receive new postings;
units.literal: For all demoted and degraded officials, those not yet given a measured transfer shall receive one;

units.zh: 已量移者與敘錄。
units.en: those already transferred will be restored to the rolls.
units.literal: those already given a measured transfer shall receive reinstatement in the registers.

units.zh: 徒流人並放還。
units.en: Convicts serving penal labor or exile are all sent home.
units.literal: Those sentenced to penal servitude or exile are all released and sent home.

units.zh: 應系欠省錢，家業抵當外並放。
units.en: Debts to the provincial treasury beyond what household assets can cover are forgiven.
units.literal: All arrears owed to the provincial treasury beyond what household property can secure are remitted.

units.zh: 宜以國號為大漢，年號依舊稱『天福』」云。
units.en: The realm shall be called Great Han, and the reign era shall still be Tianfu.' So it was proclaimed.
units.literal: The state name should be Great Han, and the reign title should continue to be called "Tianfu."' Thus it was.

units.zh: 己巳，詔青州、襄州、安州復為節鎮，曹、陳二州依舊為郡。
units.en: On jisi an edict restored Qing, Xiang, and An to full military governorships while Cao and Chen remained ordinary prefectures.
units.literal: On jisi an edict restored Qing, Xiang, and An prefectures to circuit-military status; Cao and Chen prefectures remained commanderies as before.

units.zh: 壬申，北京留守劉崇加同平章事。
units.en: On renshen Northern Capital defender Liu Chong was made grand councillor of the second rank.
units.literal: On renshen Liu Chong, Defender of the Northern Capital, was given the additional title of Grand Councillor of the Second Class.

units.zh: 以中書舍人劉繼儒為宗正卿；
units.en: Secretariat drafter Liu Jiru was appointed director of the imperial clan;
units.literal: Liu Jiru, Secretariat drafter, was made Director of the Imperial Clan;

units.zh: 翰林學士承旨、尚書兵部侍郎張允落職守本官；
units.en: Zhang Yun, Hanlin expositor-in-chief and vice minister of war, was reduced to his substantive rank alone;
units.literal: Zhang Yun, Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War in the Ministry of War, was stripped of his additional posts and retained his base office;

units.zh: 以尚書左丞張昭為吏部侍郎；
units.en: left vice director Zhang Zhao was made vice minister of personnel;
units.literal: Zhang Zhao, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Vice Minister of Personnel;

units.zh: 以左散騎常侍邊歸讜為禮部侍郎；
units.en: left cavalry attendant Bian Guidan was made vice minister of rites;
units.literal: Bian Guidan, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Vice Minister of Rites;

units.zh: 以左散騎常侍王仁裕為戶部侍郎，充翰林學士承旨；
units.en: left cavalry attendant Wang Renyu was made vice minister of revenue and Hanlin expositor-in-chief;
units.literal: Wang Renyu, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Vice Minister of Revenue and served as Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief;

units.zh: 以右諫議大夫張沆為左散騎常侍，充翰林學士；
units.en: right remonstrance grandee Zhang Hong was made left cavalry attendant and Hanlin academician;
units.literal: Zhang Hong, Right Remonstrance Grandee, was made Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry and served as Hanlin Academician;

units.zh: 以戶部侍郎李式為光祿卿；
units.en: vice minister of revenue Li Shi was appointed director of the court of imperial entertainments;
units.literal: Li Shi, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments;

units.zh: 以翰林學士、尚書禮部侍郎邊光範為衛尉卿。
units.en: Hanlin academician and vice minister of rites Bian Guangfan was appointed director of the Court of the Imperial Insignia.
units.literal: Bian Guangfan, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Rites in the Ministry of Rites, was made Director of the Court for the Imperial Clan.

units.zh: 甲戌，詔：「文武臣僚，每遇內殿起居，輪次上封事。」
units.en: On jiaxu an edict ordered that at each inner-court audience civil and military officials should take turns submitting sealed memorials.'
units.literal: On jiaxu an edict proclaimed: 'Civil and military officials, whenever they attend inner-court levee, shall in rotation submit sealed memorials.'

units.zh: 丁丑，以湖南節度使馬希範卒，輟視朝三日。
units.en: On dingchou court was closed for three days upon the death of Hunan governor Ma Xifan.
units.literal: On dingchou, because Ma Xifan, military governor of Hunan, had died, court audiences were suspended for three days.

units.zh: 是月，契丹所命相州節度使高唐英為屯駐指揮使王繼宏、楚暉所殺。
units.en: That month Gao Tangying, the Khitan-appointed governor of Xiang, was killed by garrison commanders Wang Jihong and Chu Hui.
units.literal: That month Gao Tangying, military governor of Xiang Prefecture as appointed by the Khitan, was killed by Wang Jihong and Chu Hui, commanders of the Garrison Army.

units.zh: 秋七月己丑，以御史中丞趙上交為太僕卿，以戶部侍郎邊蔚為御史中丞。
units.en: In the seventh month, on jichou, censor-in-chief Zhao Shangjiao became director of the imperial stud and vice minister of revenue Bian Wei became censor-in-chief.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jichou Zhao Shangjiao, Censor-in-Chief, was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud; Bian Wei, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 甲午，武安軍節度副使、水陸諸軍副都指揮使、判內外諸司、江南西道觀察等使、檢校太尉馬希廣加檢校太師、兼中書令，行潭州大都督、天策上將軍，充武安軍節度、湖南管內觀察使、江南諸道都統，封楚王。
units.en: On jiawu Ma Xiguang—deputy Wu'an governor, joint land-and-sea commander, and Jiangnan West observer—was promoted to honorary grand preceptor and director of the secretariat, given acting rank as Tanzhou grand general and heavenly-strategies supreme general, confirmed as Wu'an governor, Hunan observer, and commander of all Jiangnan circuits, and enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.
units.literal: On jiawu Ma Xiguang, deputy military governor of the Wu'an Army, deputy overall commander of land and water forces, administrator of inner and outer offices, Jiangnan West Circuit observation commissioner, and Honorary Grand Commandant, was given the additional titles of Honorary Grand Preceptor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat; he acted as Grand General of Tan Prefecture and Supreme General of the Heavenly Strategies, filled the posts of Wu'an military governor, Hunan circuit observation commissioner, and overall commander of the Jiangnan circuits, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.

units.zh: 丙申，以鄴都留守、天雄軍節度使、檢校太師、守太傅、兼中書令、衛國公杜重威為宋州節度使，加守太尉；
units.en: On bingshen Yedu defender and Tianxiong governor Du Chongwei, Duke of Wei, was transferred to Songzhou and promoted to acting grand guardian;
units.literal: On bingshen Du Chongwei, Defender of Yedu, military governor of the Tianxiong Army, Honorary Grand Preceptor, Acting Grand Tutor, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and Duke of Wei, was made military governor of Song and given the additional Acting Grand Guardian;

units.zh: 以宋州節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令高行周為鄴都留守，加守太傅；
units.en: Song governor Gao Xingzhou became Yedu defender with the added rank of acting grand tutor;
units.literal: Gao Xingzhou, military governor of Song, Honorary Grand Preceptor, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, was made Defender of Yedu and given the additional Acting Grand Tutor;

units.zh: 以鄆州節度使、檢校太師、兼侍中李守貞為河中節度使，加兼中書令；
units.en: Yanzhou governor Li Shouzhen was moved to Hezhong and made concurrent director of the secretariat;
units.literal: Li Shouzhen, military governor of Yan, Honorary Grand Preceptor, and concurrent Palace Attendant, was made military governor of Hezhong and given the additional concurrent Director of the Secretariat;

units.zh: 以河中節度使、檢校太尉趙贊為晉昌軍節度使；
units.en: Hezhong governor Zhao Zan was transferred to the Jinchang command;
units.literal: Zhao Zan, military governor of Hezhong and Honorary Grand Commandant, was made military governor of the Jinchang Army;

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·趙贊傳》：贊懼漢疑己，潛遣親吏趙仙奉表歸蜀。
units.en: (The Song History biography of Zhao Zan records that fearing Han suspicion, he secretly sent his aide Zhao Xian with a memorial offering submission to Shu.)
units.literal: (According to the Song History, Biography of Zhao Zan: Zan feared that the Han court suspected him and secretly sent his personal clerk Zhao Xian to present a memorial and submit to Shu.)

units.zh: 判官李恕者，趙延壽賓佐，深所委賴，至家事亦參之，及贊出鎮，從為上介。
units.en: His aide Li Shu had been Zhao Yanshou's trusted adviser, even consulted on family matters; when Zan took up his governorship Shu went with him as chief administrator.
units.literal: The administrative aide Li Shu had been a guest-official of Zhao Yanshou, deeply relied upon—even household affairs were entrusted to him—and when Zan went out to a command, Shu followed as chief aide.

units.zh: 至是，恕語贊曰：「燕王入遼，非所願也，漢方建國，必務懷柔。
units.en: Now Shu told Zan: 'The Prince of Yan's captivity in Liao was not his choice. The new Han regime will surely seek to win men over gently.
units.literal: At this time Shu said to Zan: 'The Prince of Yan's going into Liao was not of his own wish. The Han are just establishing their state and are sure to practice gentle reassurance.

units.zh: 公若泥首歸朝，必保富貴；
units.en: If you prostrate yourself and return to court, your wealth and rank are secure;
units.literal: If you bow your head and return to court, you are certain to preserve wealth and rank;

units.zh: 狼狽入蜀，理難萬全。
units.en: fleeing in disarray to Shu can scarcely be a safe course.
units.literal: to flee in disorder into Shu can hardly be fully safe in reason.

units.zh: 儻若不容，後悔無及。
units.en: If they reject you, it will be too late for regret.
units.literal: If perchance you are not accepted, regret will come too late.

units.zh: 公能聽納，請先入朝為公申理。」
units.en: If you agree, let me go to court first and explain your situation.'
units.literal: If you can heed and accept this, allow me to enter court first and plead your case on your behalf.'

units.zh: 贊即遣恕詣闕。
units.en: Zan immediately sent Shu to the capital.
units.literal: Zan at once sent Shu to the palace.

units.zh: 漢祖見恕，問贊何以附蜀。
units.en: The Han founder received Shu and asked why Zhao Zan had sought Shu.
units.literal: The Han Founder received Shu and asked why Zan had attached himself to Shu.

units.zh: 恕曰：「贊家在燕薊，身受契丹之命，自懷憂恐，謂陛下終不能容，招引西軍，蓋圖茍免。
units.en: Shu replied: 'Zan's kin are in Yanji. Bound to the Khitan, he feared Your Majesty would never trust him; reaching out to western forces was only a desperate bid to survive.
units.literal: Shu said: 'Zan's family is in Yan and Ji. He bore an appointment from the Khitan and inwardly feared that Your Majesty would never tolerate him; summoning western troops was merely plotting to save himself as best he could.

units.zh: 臣意國家甫定，務安臣民，所以令臣乞哀求覲。」
units.en: I believed the new dynasty would seek to reassure its subjects, and so I came to beg an audience on his behalf.'
units.literal: I thought the state had just been settled and would strive to reassure officials and people, and therefore had me beg humbly to request an audience.'

units.zh: 漢祖曰：「贊之父子，亦吾人也，事契丹出於不幸。
units.en: The founder said: 'The Zans are our own people; serving the Khitan was misfortune.
units.literal: The Han Founder said: 'Zan and his father are also our people; serving the Khitan came from misfortune.

units.zh: 今聞延壽落於陷阱，吾忍不容贊耶！」
units.en: Now that Yanshou is trapped, how could I refuse to accept Zan!'
units.literal: Now I hear Yanshou has fallen into a trap—how could I bear not to tolerate Zan!'

units.zh: 恕未還，贊巳離鎮入朝，即命為左驍衛將軍。）〉
units.en: Before Shu returned, Zan had already left his post for court and was immediately appointed general of the left valiant cavalry guard.)〉
units.literal: Before Shu returned, Zan had already left his command and entered court, and was at once appointed General of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard.)〉

units.zh: 以晉昌軍節度使張彥超為鄜州節度使，加檢校太師。
units.en: Jinchang governor Zhang Yanchao was transferred to Yanzhou and made honorary grand preceptor.
units.literal: Zhang Yanchao, military governor of the Jinchang Army, was made military governor of Yan and given the additional Honorary Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 庚子，以徐州節度使、檢校太師、同平章事、岐國公符彥卿為兗州節度使，加兼侍中；
units.en: On gengzi Xu governor Fu Yanqing, Duke of Qi, was moved to Yanzhou and made concurrent palace attendant;
units.literal: On gengzi Fu Yanqing, military governor of Xu, Honorary Grand Preceptor, Grand Councillor of the Second Class, and Duke of Qi, was made military governor of Yan and given the additional concurrent Palace Attendant;

units.zh: 以鄧州節度使、檢校太師王周為徐州節度使，加同平章事；
units.en: Deng governor Wang Zhou became Xu governor and grand councillor of the second rank;
units.literal: Wang Zhou, military governor of Deng and Honorary Grand Preceptor, was made military governor of Xu and given Grand Councillor of the Second Class;

units.zh: 以許州節度使、檢校太保劉重進為鄧州節度使，加檢校太傅；
units.en: Xu governor Liu Chongjin was transferred to Deng and promoted to honorary grand tutor;
units.literal: Liu Chongjin, military governor of Xu and Honorary Grand Mentor, was made military governor of Deng and given the additional Honorary Grand Tutor;

units.zh: 以兗州節度使、檢校太師、兼侍中安審琦為襄州節度使；
units.en: Yanzhou governor An Shenqi was appointed governor of Xiang;
units.literal: An Shenqi, military governor of Yan, Honorary Grand Preceptor, and concurrent Palace Attendant, was made military governor of Xiang;

units.zh: 檢校太師、莒國公李從敏為西京留守，加同平章事；
units.en: Li Congmin, Duke of Ju, became Western Capital defender and grand councillor;
units.literal: Li Congmin, Honorary Grand Preceptor and Duke of Ju, was made Defender of the Western Capital and given Grand Councillor of the Second Class;

units.zh: 以鳳翔節度使、檢校太師、同平章事侯益依前鳳翔節度使，加兼侍中。
units.en: Fengxiang governor Hou Yi kept his post and was made concurrent palace attendant.
units.literal: Hou Yi, military governor of Fengxiang, Honorary Grand Preceptor, and Grand Councillor of the Second Class, remained as before military governor of Fengxiang and was given the additional concurrent Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 辛丑，故守司空兼門下侍郎、平章事、譙國公劉旬贈太保。
units.en: On xinchou the late grand councillor Liu Xun, Duke of Qiao, was posthumously honored as grand tutor.
units.literal: On xinchou the late Acting Minister of Works, concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councillor, and Duke of Qiao, Liu Xun, was posthumously given Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 甲辰，華州節度使侯章、同州節度使張彥威、涇州節度使史威，並加檢校太尉。
units.en: On jiachen the governors of Hua, Tong, and Jing—Hou Zhang, Zhang Yanwei, and Shi Wei—were all promoted to honorary Grand Commandant.
units.literal: On jiachen Hou Zhang, military governor of Hua; Zhang Yanwei, military governor of Tong; and Shi Wei, military governor of Jing, were all given the additional Honorary Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 以晉昌軍節度使、檢校太保劉銖為青州節度使，加檢校太尉、同平章事；
units.en: Jinchang governor Liu Zhu was made Qing governor with the added ranks of honorary Grand Commandant and grand councillor;
units.literal: Liu Zhu, military governor of the Jinchang Army and Honorary Grand Guardian, was made military governor of Qing and given the additional Honorary Grand Commandant and Grand Councillor of the Second Class;

units.zh: 以河中節度使、檢校太尉白文珂為鄆州節度使，加同平章事；
units.en: Hezhong governor Bai Wenke was transferred to Yunzhou and made grand councillor;
units.literal: Bai Wenke, military governor of Hezhong and Honorary Grand Commandant, was made military governor of Yun and given Grand Councillor of the Second Class;

units.zh: 以青州節度使楊承信為安州節度使，加檢校太傅；
units.en: Qing governor Yang Chengxin was moved to Anzhou and made honorary grand tutor;
units.literal: Yang Chengxin, military governor of Qing, was made military governor of An and given the additional Honorary Grand Tutor;

units.zh: 滑州節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使劉信、許州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使史宏肇，並加檢校太尉。
units.en: Hua governor and horse-guard commander Liu Xin and Xu governor and foot-guard commander Shi Hongzhao were both promoted to honorary Grand Commandant.
units.literal: Liu Xin, military governor of Hua and concurrent overall commander of the palace horse guards, and Shi Hongzhao, military governor of Xu and concurrent overall commander of the palace foot guards, were both given the additional Honorary Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 庚戌，以司天監任延浩為殿中監，以司天少監杜升為司天監。
units.en: On gengxu astronomical director Ren Yanhao became director of the palace library, and deputy director Du Sheng succeeded him as astronomical director.
units.literal: On gengxu Ren Yanhao, Director of the Astronomical Bureau, was made Director of the Palace Library; Du Sheng, Deputy Director of the Astronomical Bureau, was made Director of the Astronomical Bureau.

units.zh: 是月，契丹永康王烏裕囚祖母舒嚕氏於木葉山。
units.en: That month Khitan Prince Yongkang Wu Yu imprisoned his grandmother Lady Shulu on Mount Muye.
units.literal: That month the Khitan Prince of Yongkang, Wu Yu, imprisoned his grandmother Lady Shulu on Muye Mountain.

units.zh: 閏月辛酉，以左衛上將軍皇甫立為太子太師致仕。
units.en: In the intercalary month, on xinyou, left guards general Huangfu Li was made grand preceptor of the heir apparent and retired from office.
units.literal: In the intercalary month, on xinyou Huangfu Li, General of the Left Guards, was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired.

units.zh: 乙丑，禁造契丹樣鞍轡、器械、服裝。
units.en: On yichou the court banned the manufacture of Khitan-style saddlery, arms, and dress.
units.literal: On yichou the manufacture of Khitan-style saddles and bridles, weapons, and clothing was forbidden.

units.zh: 故開封尹桑維翰贈尚書令，故西京留守景延廣贈中書令，以前衛尉卿薛仁謙為司農卿。
units.en: The late Kaifeng prefect Sang Weihan was posthumously honored as director of the department of state affairs, the late Western Capital defender Jing Yanguang as director of the secretariat, and former imperial-clan court director Xue Renqian was appointed director of the national granaries.
units.literal: The late Prefect of Kaifeng Sang Weihan was posthumously given Director of the Department of State Affairs; the late Defender of the Western Capital Jing Yanguang was posthumously given Director of the Secretariat; the former Director of the Court for the Imperial Clan Xue Renqian was made Director of the Court of the National Granaries.

units.zh: 丙寅，唐故樞密使郭崇韜贈中書令，故河中節度使安重誨贈尚書令，故華州節度使毛璋贈侍中，故汴州節度使朱守殷贈中書令。
units.en: On bingyin the late Tang military commissioner Guo Chongtao, late Hezhong governor An Chonghui, late Hua governor Mao Zhang, and late Bian governor Zhu Shouyin received posthumous honors as director of the secretariat, director of the secretariat, palace attendant, and director of the secretariat respectively.
units.literal: On bingyin the late Tang Commissioner of Military Affairs Guo Chongtao was posthumously given Director of the Secretariat; the late military governor of Hezhong An Chonghui was posthumously given Director of the Secretariat; the late military governor of Hua Mao Zhang was posthumously given Palace Attendant; the late military governor of Bian Zhu Shouyin was posthumously given Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 丁卯，故青州節度楊光遠贈尚書令，追封齊王，仍令所司追謚立碑。
units.en: On dingmao the late Qing governor Yang Guangyuan was posthumously made director of the secretariat and Prince of Qi, with orders to grant a posthumous name and set up a memorial stele.
units.literal: On dingmao the late military governor of Qing Yang Guangyuan was posthumously given Director of the Secretariat, posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Qi, and the responsible offices were ordered to confer a posthumous title and erect a stele.

units.zh: 唐故河中節度使、西平王朱友謙追封魏王，故樞密使馮赟贈中書令，故河陽節度使、判六軍康義誠贈中書令。
units.en: The late Tang Hezhong governor and Prince of Xiping Zhu Youqian was posthumously made Prince of Wei; the late military commissioner Feng Yun and late Heyang governor Kang Yicheng, who had administered the six armies, were posthumously honored as directors of the secretariat.
units.literal: The late Tang military governor of Hezhong and Prince of Xiping Zhu Youqian was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Wei; the late Commissioner of Military Affairs Feng Yun was posthumously given Director of the Secretariat; the late military governor of Heyang and administrator of the Six Armies Kang Yicheng was posthumously given Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 故西京留守、京兆尹王思同、故邠州節度使藥彥稠、故襄州節度使安重進、故鎮州節度使安重榮，並贈侍中。
units.en: The late Western Capital defender and Jingzhao prefect Wang Sitong, late Bin governor Yao Yanchou, late Xiang governor An Chongjin, and late Zhen governor An Chongrong were all posthumously honored as palace attendants.
units.literal: The late Defender of the Western Capital and Prefect of Jingzhao Wang Sitong; the late military governor of Bin Yao Yanchou; the late military governor of Xiang An Chongjin; and the late military governor of Zhen An Chongrong were all posthumously given Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 庚午，以前延州留後薛可言為宣徽北院使，以監察御史王度為樞密直學士。
units.en: On gengwu former Yanzhou acting prefect Xue Keyan became commissioner of the northern palace secretariat bureau, and investigating censor Wang Du became direct academician of the military affairs commission.
units.literal: On gengwu the former acting prefect of Yan Xue Keyan was made commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat; the investigating censor Wang Du was made direct academician of the Military Affairs Commission.

units.zh: 新授宋州節度使杜重威據鄴都叛，詔削奪重威官爵，貶為庶人。
units.en: Du Chongwei, newly appointed to Song but holding Yedu, rebelled; an edict stripped him of rank and reduced him to commoner status.
units.literal: The newly appointed military governor of Song Du Chongwei, holding Yedu, rebelled; an edict stripped Chongwei of office and rank and degraded him to commoner.

units.zh: 以高行周為行營都部署，率兵進討。
units.en: Gao Xingzhou was appointed overall campaign commander and marched to suppress the rebellion.
units.literal: Gao Xingzhou was made overall commander of the campaign army and led troops forward to attack.

units.zh: 辛未，以權樞密使楊邠為樞密使，加檢校太傅；
units.en: On xinwei acting military commissioner Yang Bin became full commissioner with the added rank of honorary grand tutor;
units.literal: On xinwei Yang Bin, acting Commissioner of Military Affairs, was made Commissioner of Military Affairs and given the additional Honorary Grand Tutor;

units.zh: 以權樞密副使郭威為副樞密使，加檢校太保；
units.en: acting deputy commissioner Guo Wei was confirmed as deputy commissioner and made honorary grand mentor;
units.literal: Guo Wei, acting Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs, was made Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs and given the additional Honorary Grand Mentor;

units.zh: 以權三司使王章為三司使，加檢校太傅。
units.en: acting finance commissioner Wang Zhang was made full commissioner with the added rank of honorary grand tutor.
units.literal: Wang Zhang, acting Commissioner of the Three Departments, was made Commissioner of the Three Departments and given the additional Honorary Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 壬申，故晉昌軍節度使趙在禮贈中書令，故曹州節度使石赟贈侍中，故滑州節度使皇甫遇贈中書令。
units.en: On renshen the late Jinchang governor Zhao Zaili and late Hua governor Huangfu Yu were posthumously made directors of the secretariat, and the late Cao governor Shi Yun was made palace attendant.
units.literal: On renshen the late military governor of the Jinchang Army Zhao Zaili was posthumously given Director of the Secretariat; the late military governor of Cao Shi Yun was posthumously given Palace Attendant; the late military governor of Hua Huangfu Yu was posthumously given Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 故曹州節度使劉繼鄖、故滑州節度使梁漢璋，皆贈太尉；
units.en: The late Cao governor Liu Jiyun and late Hua governor Liang Hanzhang were both posthumously honored as grand guardian;
units.literal: The late military governor of Cao Liu Jiyun and the late military governor of Hua Liang Hanzhang were both posthumously given Grand Guardian;

units.zh: 故宣徽使孟承誨贈太保。
units.en: The late palace domestic commissioner Meng Chenghui was posthumously honored as grand preceptor.
units.literal: The late Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service Meng Chenghui was posthumously given Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 丁丑，有彗出於張，旬日而滅。
units.en: On dingchou a comet appeared in the Zhang asterism and faded after ten days.
units.literal: On dingchou a comet appeared in the Zhang constellation; in ten days it vanished.

units.zh: 己卯，陜州節度使趙暉加階爵，晉州節度使王晏加檢校太尉，河陽節度使武行德加階爵，延州節度使高允權加檢校太尉。
units.en: On jimao Shan governor Zhao Hui received a higher noble rank, Jin governor Wang Yan was made honorary Grand Commandant, Heyang governor Wu Xingde was promoted in rank, and Yan governor Gao Yunquan was made honorary Grand Commandant.
units.literal: On jimao Zhao Hui, military governor of Shan, was given added rank and enfeoffment; Wang Yan, military governor of Jin, was given the additional Honorary Grand Commandant; Wu Xingde, military governor of Heyang, was given added rank and enfeoffment; Gao Yunquan, military governor of Yan, was given the additional Honorary Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 鄧州節度使常思加檢校太尉，移鎮潞州。
units.en: Deng governor Chang Si was made honorary Grand Commandant and transferred to Lu Prefecture.
units.literal: Chang Si, military governor of Deng, was given the additional Honorary Grand Commandant and transferred to garrison at Lu.

units.zh: 庚辰，追尊六廟，以太祖高皇帝、世祖光武皇帝為不祧之廟，高曾已下四朝，追尊謚號，已載於前矣。
units.en: On gengchen the court enshrined the six ancestral temples, setting Emperor Gaozu the High and Emperor Guangwu the Bright Martial as permanent temples never to be removed, while the posthumous titles of the four earlier generations had already been given above.
units.literal: On gengchen the six ancestral temples were posthumously honored; the High Ancestor Emperor Gaozu and the Bright Martial Ancestor Emperor Guangwu were made undislodgeable temples; the four preceding generations from the High and Remote Ancestors downward had posthumous titles already recorded above.

units.zh: 是日，權太常卿張昭上六廟樂章舞名：太祖高皇帝室酌獻，請依舊奏《武德之舞》；
units.en: That day acting minister of rites Zhang Zhao submitted the ritual music and dances for the six temples: for the libation at Emperor Gaozu the High's shrine, he asked that the old Dance of Martial Virtue be performed as before;
units.literal: That day Acting Minister of Rites Zhang Zhao submitted the names of the music and dances for the six temples: for the libation offering at the shrine of Emperor Gaozu the High, he requested that the old "Dance of Martial Virtue" be performed as before;

units.zh: 世祖光武皇帝室酌獻，請依舊奏《大武之舞》；
units.en: for Emperor Guangwu the Bright Martial's shrine, he asked that the old Great Martial Dance be performed as before;
units.literal: for the libation offering at the shrine of Emperor Guangwu the Bright Martial, he requested that the old "Great Martial Dance" be performed as before;

units.zh: 文祖明元皇帝室酌獻，請奏《靈長之舞》；
units.en: for Emperor Mingyuan the Literary Ancestor's shrine, he proposed the Dance of Enduring Spirit;
units.literal: for the libation offering at the shrine of Emperor Mingyuan the Literary Ancestor, he requested the performance of "Dance of Enduring Spirit";

units.zh: 德祖恭僖皇帝室酌獻，請奏《積善之舞》；
units.en: for Emperor Gongxi the Reverent and Joyful Ancestor's shrine, the Dance of Accumulated Goodness;
units.literal: for the libation offering at the shrine of Emperor Gongxi the Reverent and Joyful Ancestor, he requested the performance of "Dance of Accumulated Goodness";

units.zh: 翼祖昭獻皇帝室酌獻，請奏《顯仁之舞》；
units.en: for Emperor Zhaoxian the Assisting Ancestor's shrine, the Dance of Manifest Benevolence;
units.literal: for the libation offering at the shrine of Emperor Zhaoxian the Assisting Ancestor, he requested the performance of "Dance of Manifest Benevolence";

units.zh: 顯祖章聖皇帝室酌獻，請奏《章慶之舞》。
units.en: for Emperor Zhangsheng the Illustrious Ancestor's shrine, the Dance of Glorious Celebration.
units.literal: for the libation offering at the shrine of Emperor Zhangsheng the Illustrious Ancestor, he requested the performance of "Dance of Glorious Celebration."

units.zh: 其六廟歌詞，文多不錄。
units.en: The hymn texts for the six temples are largely omitted here.
units.literal: As for the hymn texts of the six temples, most of the wording is not recorded here.

units.zh: 八月壬午朔，鎮州駐屯護聖左廂都指揮使白再榮等，逐契丹所命節度使麻答，復其城。
units.en: On the first day of the eighth month, Bai Zairong, left-wing commander of the imperial guard at Zhenzhou, expelled the Khitan appointee Mada and recaptured the city.
units.literal: On the first day (renwu) of the eighth month, Bai Zairong and others, Left Wing overall commander of the Imperial Guard garrisoned at Zhenzhou, drove out Mada, the military governor appointed by the Khitan, and recovered the city.

units.zh: 麻答與河陽節度使崔廷勛、洛京留守劉晞，並奔定州。
units.en: Mada fled with Heyang governor Cui Tingxun and Luoyang defender Liu Xi, all making for Ding Prefecture.
units.literal: Mada, together with Cui Tingxun, military governor of Heyang, and Liu Xi, defender of the Luoyang capital, all fled to Dingzhou.

units.zh: 馳驛以聞。
units.en: Word was sent to court by urgent relay.
units.literal: An express relay was dispatched to report it.

units.zh: 庚寅，以洺州團練使薛懷讓為邢州節度使。
units.en: On gengyin Luo regimentation commissioner Xue Huairang was appointed military governor of Xing.
units.literal: On gengyin Xue Huairang, regimentation commissioner of Luo, was made military governor of Xing.

units.zh: 辛卯，詔恒州復為鎮州，順國軍復為成德軍。
units.en: On xinmao an edict restored the name Heng Prefecture to Zhen and the Shunguo Army to Chengde.
units.literal: On xinmao an edict restored Heng Prefecture to Zhen Prefecture and the Shunguo Army to the Chengde Army.

units.zh: 乙未，以護聖左廂都指揮使、恩州團練使白再榮為鎮州留後。
units.en: On yiwei Bai Zairong, left-wing imperial guard commander and En regimentation commissioner, was made acting governor of Zhen.
units.literal: On yiwei Bai Zairong, Left Wing overall commander of the Imperial Guard and regimentation commissioner of En, was made acting military governor of Zhen.

units.zh: 丙申，詔天下凡關賊盜，不計贓物多少，案驗不虛，並處死。
units.en: On bingshen an edict ruled that anyone convicted of robbery or banditry anywhere in the realm, whatever the value stolen, was to be executed once the case was substantiated.
units.literal: On bingshen an edict declared that throughout the realm, in all cases of robbery and banditry, regardless of the amount of stolen goods, if investigation proved the charges true, all were to be put to death.

units.zh: 以兩浙節度使、守太師、兼中書令、吳越國王錢宏佐薨，廢朝三日。
units.en: Upon the death of Qian Hongzuo, governor of the Two Zhes, defender grand preceptor, director of the secretariat, and king of Wuyue, court was closed for three days.
units.literal: Because Qian Hongzuo, military governor of the Two Zhes, Defender Grand Preceptor, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and King of Wuyue, had died, court audiences were suspended for three days.

units.zh: 丙午，以吐渾府節度使、檢校太尉王義宗為沁州刺史，依前吐渾節度使。
units.en: On bingwu Tuyuhun governor Wang Yizong was appointed prefect of Qin while retaining his Tuyuhun command.
units.literal: On bingwu Wang Yizong, military governor of the Tuyuhun Prefecture and Honorary Grand Commandant, was made prefect of Qin while continuing as before as military governor of Tuyuhun.

units.zh: 己酉，以刑部尚書竇貞固為吏部尚書。
units.en: On jiyou Minister of Justice Dou Zhengu was appointed minister of personnel.
units.literal: On jiyou Dou Zhengu, Minister of Justice, was made Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 是日，薛懷讓奏，收復邢州，殺偽命節度副使、知州事劉鐸。
units.en: That day Xue Huairang reported the recovery of Xing Prefecture and the killing of Liu Duo, the illicitly appointed deputy governor and acting prefect.
units.literal: That day Xue Huairang memorialized that Xing Prefecture had been recovered and that Liu Duo, illicitly appointed deputy military governor and acting prefect, had been killed.

units.zh: 初，懷讓為洺州防禦使，契丹麻答發健步督洺州糧運，懷讓殺之以聞。
units.en: Earlier, while Huairang was defense commissioner of Luo, the Khitan Mada had sent swift couriers to oversee grain shipments; Huairang killed them and reported the matter.
units.literal: Earlier, when Huairang was defense commissioner of Luo, the Khitan Mada sent swift runners to supervise grain transport from Luo; Huairang killed them and reported it.

units.zh: 帝遣郭從義與懷讓攻取邢州，蕃將楊袞來援鐸，懷讓拒之，不勝，退保洺州，敵騎掠其部，民大被其苦。
units.en: The emperor sent Guo Congyi to join Huairang in attacking Xing. The Khitan general Yang Gun came to Liu Duo's aid; Huairang resisted but was beaten back to Luo, and enemy cavalry ravaged the region, inflicting great suffering on the people.
units.literal: The Emperor dispatched Guo Congyi together with Huairang to seize Xing; the foreign general Yang Gun came to aid Duo; Huairang resisted but was defeated, withdrew to hold Luo, and enemy cavalry plundered his territory, so the people suffered greatly.

units.zh: 會鎮州逐麻答，楊袞收兵退，鐸乃上表請命。
units.en: When Zhen expelled Mada, Yang Gun withdrew; Liu Duo then memorialized requesting formal appointment.
units.literal: When Zhen drove out Mada, Yang Gun withdrew his troops; Duo then submitted a memorial requesting official appointment.

units.zh: 懷讓乘其無備，遣人紿鐸云：「奉詔襲契丹，請置頓於郡。」
units.en: Taking advantage of Duo's unpreparedness, Huairang sent a man to deceive him, saying, "By imperial order we are marching against the Khitan; please allow us to encamp in the prefectural city."
units.literal: Huairang, seizing his lack of preparedness, sent a man to deceive Duo, saying: 'By imperial order we are striking the Khitan; please allow us to encamp in the prefectural seat.'

units.zh: 鐸開門迎之，即為懷讓所害，時人冤之。
units.en: Duo opened the gates to welcome them and was immediately killed by Huairang; contemporaries regarded it as a grievous injustice.
units.literal: Duo opened the gates to welcome them and was immediately killed by Huairang; people of the time considered it an injustice.

units.zh: 鐸初受契丹命為邢州都指揮使，及永康王以高奉明為節度使，滿達勒署鐸為邢州副使兼都指揮使。
units.en: Liu Duo had first received Khitan appointment as commander of Xing; when Prince Yongkang installed Gao Fengming as governor, Manduolie made Duo deputy governor of Xing while retaining command.
units.literal: At first Duo received Khitan appointment as overall commander of Xing; when Prince Yongkang made Gao Fengming military governor, Manduolie appointed Duo deputy military governor of Xing and concurrent overall commander.

units.zh: 帝至東京，奉明歸鎮州，令鐸知邢州事，至是遇害。
units.en: When the emperor reached the Eastern Capital, Gao Fengming returned to Zhen and put Liu Duo in charge of Xing; it was then that Duo was killed.
units.literal: When the Emperor reached the Eastern Capital, Fengming returned to Zhen and ordered Duo to administer the affairs of Xing; at this time he met his death.

units.zh: 庚戌，文武百僚上表，請以二月四日降誕日為聖壽節，從之。
units.en: On gengxu the civil and military officials memorialized that the emperor's birthday, the fourth day of the second month, be observed as the Sacred Longevity Festival; the request was granted.
units.literal: On gengxu the civil and military officials submitted a memorial requesting that the fourth day of the second month, the day of the Emperor's birth, be made the Sacred Longevity Festival; the request was granted.

units.zh: 前晉昌軍節度副使李肅加左驍衛上將軍致仕。
units.en: Li Su, former deputy governor of Jinchang, was promoted to left general of the valiant cavalry guard and granted retirement.
units.literal: Li Su, former deputy military governor of the Jinchang Army, was made Left General of the Valiant Cavalry Guard and retired.

units.zh: 是月，遣使諸道和市戰馬。
units.en: That month envoys were sent to the circuits to procure war horses through official purchase.
units.literal: That month envoys were dispatched to the various circuits to purchase war horses at fair prices.

units.zh: 九月甲子，宰臣蘇逢吉兼戶部尚書，蘇禹珪兼刑部尚書。
units.en: On jiazi in the ninth month chief minister Su Fengji was given concurrent appointment as minister of revenue and Su Yugui as minister of justice.
units.literal: On jiazi in the ninth month Chief Minister Su Fengji was made concurrent Minister of Revenue and Su Yugui concurrent Minister of Justice.

units.zh: 丁卯，以吏部侍郎、權判太常卿事張昭為太常卿。
units.en: On dingmao vice minister of personnel Zhang Zhao, acting minister of rites, was appointed minister of rites.
units.literal: On dingmao Zhang Zhao, Vice Minister of Personnel and acting Minister of Rites, was made Minister of Rites.

units.zh: 戊辰，故易州刺史郭璘贈太傅。
units.en: On wuchen the late Yi prefect Guo Lin was posthumously honored as grand tutor.
units.literal: On wuchen the late Prefect of Yi Guo Lin was posthumously given Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 甲戌，宰臣蘇逢吉加左僕射、監修國史，蘇禹珪加右僕射、集賢殿大學士，以吏部尚書竇貞固為守司空兼門下侍郎、平章事、宏文館大學士，
units.en: On jiaxu chief minister Su Fengji became left vice director and supervisor of the national history; Su Yugui became right vice director and grand academician of the hall of assembled worthies; and minister of personnel Dou Zhengu was appointed defender minister of works, vice director of the chancellery, grand councillor, and grand academician of the hall of broad culture,
units.literal: On jiaxu Chief Minister Su Fengji was made Left Vice Director and Supervisor of the National History; Su Yugui was made Right Vice Director and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies; Dou Zhengu, Minister of Personnel, was made Defender Minister of Works, concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councillor, and Grand Academician of the Hall of Broad Culture,

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·竇貞固傳》：初，帝與貞固同事晉祖，甚相得。
units.en: (The Song History biography of Dou Zhengu notes that the emperor and Zhengu had once served together under Jin Gaozu and were on excellent terms.
units.literal: (According to the Song History, Biography of Dou Zhengu: At first the Emperor and Zhengu had served Emperor Gaozu of Jin together and were very well matched.

units.zh: 時蘇逢吉、蘇禹珪自霸府僚佐驟居相位，思得舊臣冠首，以貞固持重寡言，有時望，乃拜司空、門下侍郎、平章事。）〉
units.en: Su Fengji and Su Yugui had risen abruptly from the Prince of Wei's staff to the chief ministership; wishing a senior minister at their head, and finding Zhengu steady, reserved, and widely respected, they appointed him minister of works, vice director of the chancellery, and grand councillor.)〉
units.literal: At that time Su Fengji and Su Yugui had risen abruptly from staff officers of the Prince of Wei's domain to the chief ministership; wishing to place an old minister at their head, and because Zhengu was steady, sparing of speech, and enjoyed public esteem, he was appointed Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Grand Councillor.)〉

units.zh: 以翰林學士、行中書舍人李濤為中書侍郎兼戶部尚書、平章事。
units.en: Hanlin academician and acting secretariat drafter Li Tao was appointed vice director of the secretariat, concurrent minister of revenue, and grand councillor.
units.literal: Li Tao, Hanlin Academician and acting Drafting Secretary of the Secretariat, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Revenue, and Grand Councillor.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·李濤傳》：杜重威據鄴叛，高祖命高行周、慕容彥超討之，二帥不協，濤密疏親征。
units.en: (The Song History biography of Li Tao records that when Du Chongwei rebelled and held Ye, Gaozu ordered Gao Xingzhou and Murong Yanchao to suppress him; the two commanders failed to cooperate, and Tao submitted a secret memorial urging the emperor to lead the campaign in person.
units.literal: (According to the Song History, Biography of Li Tao: When Du Chongwei held Ye and rebelled, Emperor Gaozu ordered Gao Xingzhou and Murong Yanchao to suppress him; the two commanders were not in accord, and Tao submitted a secret memorial urging the Emperor to take the field in person.

units.zh: 高祖覽奏，以濤堪任宰輔，即拜中書侍郎兼戶部侍郎、平章事。）〉
units.en: Gaozu read the memorial and, judging Tao fit for high office, immediately appointed him vice director of the secretariat, concurrent vice minister of revenue, and grand councillor.)〉
units.literal: Emperor Gaozu read the memorial and, judging Tao fit for the chief ministership, immediately appointed him Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Vice Minister of Revenue, and Grand Councillor.)〉

units.zh: 是日，權太常卿張昭上疏，奏改一代樂名。
units.en: That day acting minister of rites Zhang Zhao submitted a memorial proposing changes to the dynasty's ritual music titles.
units.literal: That day Acting Minister of Rites Zhang Zhao submitted a memorial proposing a change in the names of music for one generation.

units.zh: 戊寅，詔以杜重威叛命，取今月二十九日暫幸澶、魏。
units.en: On wuyin an edict declared that because Du Chongwei had rebelled, the emperor would temporarily proceed to Chan and Wei on the twenty-ninth day of that month.
units.literal: On wuyin an edict declared that because Du Chongwei had rebelled against his commission, on the twenty-ninth day of this month the Emperor would temporarily visit Chan and Wei.

units.zh: 己卯，以前樞密使李崧為太子太傅，以前左僕射和凝為太子太保。
units.en: On jimao former military commissioner Li Song was appointed grand tutor of the heir apparent, and former left vice director He Ning grand preceptor of the heir apparent.
units.literal: On jimao the former Commissioner of Military Affairs Li Song was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, and the former Left Vice Director He Ning was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 庚辰，車駕發京師。
units.en: On gengchen the emperor departed the capital.
units.literal: On gengchen the imperial carriage departed the capital.

units.zh: 冬十月癸未，以太子太保李鏻為司徒，以太子太傅盧文紀為太子太師，以前磁州刺史李穀為左散騎常侍。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, on guiwei, grand preceptor of the heir apparent Li Lin was appointed minister of education; grand tutor Lu Wenji was made grand preceptor of the heir apparent; and former Ci prefect Li Gu was appointed left cavalry attendant.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on guiwei Li Lin, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, was made Minister of Education; Lu Wenji, Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent; Li Gu, former Prefect of Ci, was made Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·李蒨傳》：舊制，罷外郡歸本官，至是進秩，獎之也。）〉
units.en: (The Song History biography of Li Qian notes that by custom dismissal from an external post meant return to one's former office; on this occasion advancement in rank served as the reward.)〉
units.literal: (According to the Song History, Biography of Li Qian: Under the old system, when one was removed from an external prefecture one returned to one's original office; on this occasion he was promoted in rank as a reward.)〉

units.zh: 甲申，車駕次韋城。
units.en: On jiashen the emperor encamped at Weicheng.
units.literal: On jiashen the imperial carriage halted at Weicheng.

units.zh: 詔：「河北諸州見禁罪人，自十月五日昧爽以前，常赦所不原者，咸赦除之。」
units.en: An edict declared: "Among prisoners held in Hebei prefectures as of dawn on the fifth day of the tenth month—including offenses never covered by routine amnesties—all are to be fully pardoned."
units.literal: An edict proclaimed: 'Among prisoners currently held in the prefectures of Hebei, all those held before dawn on the fifth day of the tenth month—even crimes not pardoned by ordinary amnesties—are hereby fully pardoned and released.'

units.zh: 壬辰，日有黑子如雞卵。
units.en: On renchen dark blemishes appeared on the sun, each as large as a hen's egg.
units.literal: On renchen dark spots appeared on the sun, each the size of a hen's egg.

units.zh: 丙申，以相州留後王繼宏為相州節度使，加檢校太傅。
units.en: On bingshen Xiang acting prefect Wang Jihong was appointed military governor of Xiang and made honorary grand tutor.
units.literal: On bingshen Wang Jihong, acting prefect of Xiang, was made military governor of Xiang and given the additional Honorary Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 至鄴都城下。
units.en: The army arrived beneath the walls of Ye.
units.literal: They reached below the walls of the Ye capital.

units.zh: 丙午，詔都部署高行周督眾攻城，帝登高阜以觀之，時眾議未欲攻擊，副部署慕容彥超堅請攻之。
units.en: On bingwu an edict put Grand Marshal Gao Xingzhou in charge of the siege; the emperor watched from a hilltop while his commanders still debated holding back—until Deputy Marshal Murong Yanchao pressed hard for an attack.
units.literal: On bingwu an edict ordered Grand Marshal Gao Xingzhou to oversee the mass assault on the city; the Emperor climbed a high mound to watch. At the time the consensus was against attacking, but Deputy Marshal Murong Yanchao insistently urged an assault.

units.zh: 是日，王師傷夷者萬餘人，不克而退。
units.en: That day the imperial forces lost more than ten thousand men, failed to breach the city, and fell back.
units.literal: That day the imperial army suffered more than ten thousand casualties and failed to take the city, then withdrew.

units.zh: 十一月壬子，雨木冰。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on renzi, glaze ice coated the trees.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on renzi, tree ice rained down.

units.zh: 癸丑，日南至，從官稱賀於行宮。
units.en: On guichou, the winter solstice, the emperor's attendants offered their congratulations at the traveling palace.
units.literal: On guichou, the winter solstice; attendants offered congratulations at the traveling palace.

units.zh: 己未，湖南奏，荊南節度使高從誨叛。
units.en: On jiwei Hunan circuit reported that Jingnan governor Gao Conghui had risen in rebellion.
units.literal: On jiwei Hunan reported that Gao Conghui, military governor of Jingnan, had rebelled.

units.zh: 辛酉，雨木冰。
units.en: On xinyou glaze ice coated the trees again.
units.literal: On xinyou, tree ice rained down.

units.zh: 壬申，杜重威上表請命。
units.en: On renshen Du Chongwei sent up a memorial asking for instructions.
units.literal: On renshen Du Chongwei submitted a memorial requesting orders.

units.zh: 癸酉，雨木冰。
units.en: On guiyou glaze ice coated the trees once more.
units.literal: On guiyou, tree ice rained down.

units.zh: 丁丑，杜重威素服出降，待罪於宮門，詔釋其罪。
units.en: On dingchou Du Chongwei emerged in unadorned white dress to surrender, waiting in submission at the palace gate; an edict then pardoned his offenses.
units.literal: On dingchou Du Chongwei came out in plain white garments to surrender, awaiting judgment at the palace gate; an edict pardoned his crimes.

units.zh: 鄴都留守、天雄軍節度使高行周加守太尉，封臨清王。
units.en: Gao Xingzhou, Ye defender and Tianxiong governor, was raised to acting grand guardian and enfeoffed as Prince of Linqing.
units.literal: Gao Xingzhou, Defender of Ye and military governor of the Tianxiong Army, was promoted to Acting Grand Guardian and enfeoffed as Prince of Linqing.

units.zh: 以杜重威為檢校太師、守太傅、兼中書令、楚國公。
units.en: Du Chongwei was appointed honorary grand preceptor, acting grand tutor, director of the secretariat, and Duke of Chu.
units.literal: Du Chongwei was made Honorary Grand Preceptor, Acting Grand Tutor, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and Duke of Chu.

units.zh: 己卯，以許州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使史宏肇為宋州節度使、同平章事，充侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使；
units.en: On jimao Xu governor and foot-guard commander Shi Hongzhao became Song governor and grand councillor, and took command of the imperial guard horse-and-foot armies;
units.literal: On jimao Shi Hongzhao, military governor of Xu and overall commander of the palace foot guards, was made military governor of Song, Grand Councillor of the Second Class, and Commander of the Imperial Guard Horse-and-Foot Armies;

units.zh: 以滑州節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使劉信為許州節度使、同平章事，充侍衛親軍馬步軍副都指揮；
units.en: Hua governor and horse-guard commander Liu Xin became Xu governor and grand councillor, and was named deputy commander of the imperial guard horse-and-foot armies;
units.literal: Liu Xin, military governor of Hua and overall commander of the palace horse guards, was made military governor of Xu, Grand Councillor of the Second Class, and Deputy Commander of the Imperial Guard Horse-and-Foot Armies;

units.zh: 以澶州節度使慕容彥超為鄆州節度使、同平章事；
units.en: Chan governor Murong Yanchao was transferred to Yan as governor and grand councillor;
units.literal: Murong Yanchao, military governor of Chan, was made military governor of Yan and Grand Councillor of the Second Class;

units.zh: 以前定州節度使李殷為貝州節度使；
units.en: former Ding governor Li Yin was appointed Bei governor;
units.literal: Li Yin, former military governor of Ding, was made military governor of Bei;

units.zh: 以鄭州防禦使郭從義為澶州節度使。
units.en: Zheng defense commissioner Guo Congyi was made Chan governor.
units.literal: Guo Congyi, defense commissioner of Zheng, was made military governor of Chan.

units.zh: 十二月辛巳朔，以護聖左廂都指揮使、岳州防禦使李洪信為遂州節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使；
units.en: On the new moon of the twelfth month, left-wing imperial guard commander and Yue defense commissioner Li Hongxin was made Sui governor and concurrent palace foot-guard commander;
units.literal: On the first day (xinsi) of the twelfth month, Li Hongxin, Left Wing overall commander of the Imperial Guard and defense commissioner of Yue, was made military governor of Sui and concurrently overall commander of the palace foot guards;

units.zh: 以護聖右廂都指揮使、永州防禦使尚洪遷為夔州節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使。
units.en: Right-wing imperial guard commander and Yong defense commissioner Shang Hongqian was made Kui governor and concurrent palace foot-guard commander.
units.literal: Shang Hongqian, Right Wing overall commander of the Imperial Guard and defense commissioner of Yong, was made military governor of Kui and concurrently overall commander of the palace foot guards.

units.zh: 丙戌，車駕發鄴都歸京。
units.en: On bingxu the emperor left Yedu and returned to the capital.
units.literal: On bingxu the imperial carriage departed Yedu and returned to the capital.

units.zh: 癸巳，至自鄴都。
units.en: On guisi he returned from Yedu.
units.literal: On guisi he returned from Yedu.

units.zh: 甲午，以皇子開封尹承訓薨。
units.en: On jiawu imperial prince Chengxun, Kaifeng prefect, died.
units.literal: On jiawu the imperial prince Chengxun, Kaifeng prefect, died.

units.zh: 廢朝三日，追封魏王。
units.en: Court was closed for three days, and he was posthumously created Prince of Wei.
units.literal: Court audiences were suspended for three days; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Wei.

units.zh: 丁酉，帝舉哀於太平宮。
units.en: On dingyou the emperor mourned at Taiping Palace.
units.literal: On dingyou the Emperor held mourning rites at Taiping Palace.

units.zh: 庚子，司徒李鏻薨。
units.en: On gengzi minister of education Li Lin died.
units.literal: On gengzi Minister of Education Li Lin died.

units.zh: 辛丑，以前鄜州節度使郭謹為滑州節度使，加檢校太尉。
units.en: On xinchou former Fu governor Guo Jin was appointed Hua governor and promoted to honorary Grand Commandant.
units.literal: On xinchou Guo Jin, former military governor of Fu, was made military governor of Hua and given the additional Honorary Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 戊申，宿州奏，部民餓死者八百六十有七人。
units.en: On wushen Suzhou reported that 867 local commoners had died of starvation.
units.literal: On wushen Suzhou memorialized that among the local populace eight hundred sixty-seven had died of starvation.

units.zh: 乾祐元年正月辛亥朔，帝不受朝賀。
units.en: On the new moon of the first month in the first year of Qianyou, the emperor declined the usual court congratulations.
units.literal: On the first day (xinhai) of the first month in the first year of Qianyou, the Emperor did not receive court congratulations.

units.zh: 乙卯，制：「大赦天下，改天福十三年為乾祐元年。
units.en: On yimao a decree proclaimed: "A general amnesty is granted throughout the realm, and the thirteenth year of Tianfu is changed to the first year of Qianyou.
units.literal: On yimao a decree proclaimed: 'A general amnesty is granted throughout the realm, and the thirteenth year of Tianfu is changed to the first year of Qianyou.

units.zh: 自正月五日昧爽已前，犯罪人除十惡五逆外，罪無輕重，咸赦除之。」
units.en: All crimes committed before dawn on the fifth day of the first month—save the ten abominations and five capital offenses, regardless of severity—were to be wholly pardoned.'
units.literal: For all offenders before dawn on the fifth day of the first month, save the ten abominations and five capital crimes, crimes great and small alike are fully pardoned and released.'

units.zh: 己未，改御名為暠。
units.en: On jiwei the emperor's personal name was changed to Gao.
units.literal: On jiwei the imperial given name was changed to Gao.

units.zh: 辛酉，詔：「諸道行軍副使、兩使判官並不得奏薦。
units.en: On xinyou an edict ruled: "Army march deputy commissioners and judicial officers of the two commissions may no longer submit recommendations by memorial.
units.literal: On xinyou an edict proclaimed: 'Army march deputy commissioners and judicial officers of the two commissions may not submit memorial recommendations.

units.zh: 帶使相節度使許奏掌書記、支使、節度推官；
units.en: Governors who also held commissioner grand councillor rank might recommend chief secretaries, staff officers, and military-law examiners;
units.literal: Military governors holding commissioner grand councillor status may recommend chief secretaries, staff officers, and military-law examiners;

units.zh: 不帶使相節度使，許奏掌書記、節度推官。
units.en: Governors without that rank might recommend chief secretaries and military-law examiners.
units.literal: Military governors without commissioner grand councillor status may recommend chief secretaries and military-law examiners.

units.zh: 其防禦團練判官、軍事判官等聽奏。
units.en: Judicial officers of defense and training commissions, military judicial officers, and the like remained free to submit recommendations.
units.literal: Defense and training commissioner judicial officers, military judicial officers, and the like may submit recommendations.

units.zh: 所薦州縣官，帶使相節度使許薦三人；
units.en: For prefecture and county posts, governors with commissioner grand councillor rank might recommend three men;
units.literal: For recommending prefecture and county officials, military governors with commissioner grand councillor status may recommend three persons;

units.zh: 不帶使相二人；
units.en: those without it, two;
units.literal: those without commissioner status, two;

units.zh: 防禦、團練、刺史一人」云。
units.en: defense commissioners, training commissioners, and prefects, one each,' the edict concluded.
units.literal: defense commissioners, training commissioners, and prefects, one each,' it stated.

units.zh: 以前鄧州節度使、燕國公馮道為守太師，進封齊國公。
units.en: Feng Dao, former Deng governor and Duke of Yan, was made acting grand preceptor and elevated to Duke of Qi.
units.literal: Feng Dao, former military governor of Deng and Duke of Yan, was made Acting Grand Preceptor and advanced to Duke of Qi.

units.zh: 甲子，帝不豫。
units.en: On jiazi the emperor fell ill.
units.literal: On jiazi the Emperor was unwell.

units.zh: 庚午，以前宗正卿石光贊為太子賓客，以太僕卿趙上交為秘書監。
units.en: On gengwu Shi Guangzan, former director of the imperial clan court, became mentor to the heir apparent, and Zhao Shangjiao, director of the imperial stud, was appointed director of the secretariat library.
units.literal: On gengwu Shi Guangzan, former Director of the Imperial Clan Court, was made Mentor to the Heir Apparent, and Zhao Shangjiao, Director of the Imperial Stud, was made Director of the Secretariat Library.

units.zh: 丁丑，故尚書左丞韓祚贈司徒。
units.en: On dingchou the late left vice director Han Zuo was posthumously honored as minister of works.
units.literal: On dingchou the late Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Han Zuo was posthumously given Minister of Works.

units.zh: 二十七日丁丑，帝崩於萬歲殿，時年五十四。
units.en: On the twenty-seventh day, dingchou, the emperor died in Wansui Hall. He was fifty-four.
units.literal: On the twenty-seventh day, dingchou, the Emperor died in Wansui Hall at the age of fifty-four.

units.zh: 秘不發喪。
units.en: The court kept his death secret and did not yet proclaim mourning.
units.literal: The death was kept secret and no mourning was proclaimed.

units.zh: 庚辰，太傅杜重威伏誅。
units.en: On gengchen Grand Tutor Du Chongwei was put to death.
units.literal: On gengchen Grand Tutor Du Chongwei was executed.

units.zh: 〈（《契丹國志》云：漢祖召蘇逢吉、楊邠、史宏肇入受顧命，曰：「承祐幼弱，後事托在卿輩。」
units.en: (The Records of the Khitan State relate that the Han founder summoned Su Fengji, Yang Bin, and Shi Hongzhao to receive his deathbed charge, saying, "Chengyou is still a child; I entrust what follows to you."
units.literal: (According to the Records of the Khitan State: The Han Founder summoned Su Fengji, Yang Bin, and Shi Hongzhao to receive his final testament, saying: 'Chengyou is young and weak; the affairs that follow I entrust to you.'

units.zh: 又曰：「善防杜重威。」
units.en: He added, "Guard yourselves against Du Chongwei."
units.literal: He also said: 'Guard carefully against Du Chongwei.'

units.zh: 是日殂。
units.en: That same day he expired.
units.literal: That same day he died.

units.zh: 逢吉等秘不發喪，下詔稱：「重威父子，因朕小疾，謗議搖眾，皆斬之。」
units.en: Fengji and his colleagues concealed the death and issued an edict in the emperor's name: "Du Chongwei and his son, exploiting my minor illness, spread slander and unsettled the people—both shall be executed."
units.literal: Fengji and the others kept the death secret and issued an edict declaring: 'Du Chongwei, father and son, taking advantage of my slight illness, slandered and stirred the multitude—all are to be beheaded.'

units.zh: 磔死於市，市人爭啖其肉。）〉
units.en: They were torn apart and executed in the market; townspeople fought over their flesh.)〉
units.literal: They were dismembered and put to death in the marketplace; townspeople vied to eat their flesh.)〉

units.zh: 二月辛巳朔，內降遺制，皇子周王承祐可於柩前即皇帝位。
units.en: On the new moon of the second month a testamentary edict issued from within the palace: Imperial Prince Zhou Wang Chengyou was to ascend the throne immediately before the coffin.
units.literal: On the first day (xinsi) of the second month an edict was issued from within proclaiming the testamentary ordinance: Imperial Prince Zhou Wang Chengyou may immediately ascend the throne before the coffin.

units.zh: 是日發哀。
units.en: That day the court publicly proclaimed the mourning.
units.literal: That day mourning was proclaimed.

units.zh: 其年二月，太常卿張昭上謚曰睿文聖武昭肅孝皇帝，廟號高祖。
units.en: Later that second month, Minister of Rites Zhang Zhao proposed the posthumous title Sagaciously Cultured, Sacredly Martial, Solemnly Reverent, and Filially Devoted Emperor, with the temple name Gaozu.
units.literal: In the second month of that year, Minister of Rites Zhang Zhao submitted a posthumous title: Sagaciously Cultured, Sacredly Martial, Solemnly Reverent, and Filially Devoted Emperor; temple name Gaozu.

units.zh: 十一月壬申，葬於睿陵，宰臣蘇禹珪撰謚冊、哀冊文雲。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on renshen, he was buried at Ruiling; Chief Minister Su Yugui wrote the texts for the posthumous-title scroll and the lamentation scroll.
units.literal: In the eleventh month on renshen he was buried at Ruiling; Chief Minister Su Yugui composed the eulogy scroll and lamentation scroll texts.

units.zh: 〈（《五代史補》：高祖嘗在晉祖麾下，晉祖既起太原，因高祖遂有天下。
units.en: (The Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties records that Gaozu had once served under Jin Gaozu; when the Jin founder rose at Taiyuan, it was through Gaozu that the house came to rule the realm.
units.literal: (According to the Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties: Gaozu once served under Emperor Gaozu of Jin; when the Jin founder rose at Taiyuan, it was through Gaozu that he thereafter possessed the realm.

units.zh: 先是，豫章有僧號上藍者，精於術數，自唐末著讖云：「石榴花發石榴開。」
units.en: Earlier, at Yuzhang, a monk called Shanglan, skilled in divination, had composed a prophecy in late Tang times: "When the pomegranate blooms, the pomegranate opens."
units.literal: Earlier, in Yuzhang there was a monk called Shanglan skilled in numerology who from the late Tang composed a prophecy saying: 'When the pomegranate flowers, the pomegranate opens.'

units.zh: 議者以「石榴」則晉、漢之謂也，再言「石榴」者，明享祚俱不過二世矣。）〉
units.en: Commentators read "pomegranate" as a reference to Jin and Han; the doubled "pomegranate" showed that both dynasties would rule for no more than two generations.)〉
units.literal: Commentators took 'pomegranate' to refer to Jin and Han; to speak of 'pomegranate' twice made clear that both would enjoy the throne for no more than two generations.)〉

units.zh: 史臣曰：在昔皇天降禍，諸夏無君。
units.en: The historian writes: In former times Heaven sent calamity upon the land, and the Chinese realms were left without a ruler.
units.literal: The historiographer states: In former times Heaven on High sent down calamity, and the myriad Chinese lands had no ruler.

units.zh: 漢高祖肇起並、汾，遄臨汴、洛，乘虛而取神器，因亂而有帝圖，雖曰人謀，諒由天啟。
units.en: Han Gaozu first rose in Bing and Fen, then swiftly advanced on Bian and Luoyang, seized the imperial regalia when the realm lay open, and won his imperial design amid chaos—though men called it human contrivance, it was surely Heaven's opening.
units.literal: Han Gaozu first rose in Bing and Fen, swiftly came to Bian and Luo, seized the regalia of rule by exploiting a void, and through turmoil obtained the imperial design; though called human planning, surely it was opened by Heaven.

units.zh: 然帝昔蒞戎藩，素虧物望，洎登宸極，未厭人心，徒矜拯溺之功，莫契來蘇之望。
units.en: Yet when he had held a military command, he had long lacked public esteem; once enthroned he still failed to win men's hearts, boasting only of rescuing the drowning while never fulfilling the people's hope of renewal.
units.literal: Yet when the Emperor formerly held a military fief, he had long fallen short of public esteem; when he ascended the imperial throne, he did not satisfy the people's hearts, boasting only the merit of rescuing the drowning while failing to meet the hope of returning life to ease.

units.zh: 良以急於止殺，不暇崇仁。
units.en: This was because he was intent on stopping the killing and had no time to cultivate benevolent rule.
units.literal: Truly he was eager to stop killing and had no leisure to exalt benevolence.

units.zh: 燕薊降師，既連營而受戮；
units.en: Troops who had surrendered from Yan and Ji were put to the sword camp after camp;
units.literal: Surrendered troops of Yan and Ji were slaughtered camp after camp;

units.zh: 鄴臺叛帥，因閉壘以偷生。
units.en: while the rebel commander at Ye preserved his life by shutting himself within the fortress.
units.literal: the rebel commander at Ye, by shutting the fortress, stole his life.

units.zh: 蓋撫禦以乖方，俾征伐之不息。
units.en: In the end his methods of pacification and control were misapplied, and warfare never ceased.
units.literal: In sum, his pacification and control were at odds with the proper method, so that campaigns and attacks never ceased.

units.zh: 及回鑾輅，尋墮烏號，故雖有應運之名，而未睹為君之德也。
units.en: When the imperial carriage returned, he soon fell from his horse; thus, though he bore the name of a man who answered his age, the virtue of true kingship was never seen in him.
units.literal: When the imperial carriage returned, he soon fell from the Black-haired Bow; therefore, though he bore the name of one who answered the age, one did not yet see the virtue of a true ruler.
